newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BHP SAYS RENEGOTIATING HBI CONTRACTS.
newsitem.headline: BHP SAYS RENEGOTIATING HBI CONTRACTS.

text.p: The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday it was renegotiating contracts to build its A$1.65 billion hot briquetted iron (HBI) plant in the Pilbara region of Western Australia.
Asked at a news conference if BHP was renegotiating terms with contractors, managing director John Prescott said: "We ... are more renegotiating the impact of those contracts."
Cost over-runs at the HBI project were blamed for the resignations of minerals division chief Dick Carter and iron ore head Geoff Wedlock this week.
